name: PR detail shows the seeded review run, verdict, and findings
description: From PR #482, open the Agent runs tab and confirm the seeded review run renders (verdict 'request changes', 2 findings) in its accordion header. The newest run's accordion is open by default (FindingsTab passes defaultOpen to the first run), so the VerdictBanner and the seeded FindingCard ('Hardcoded Stripe secret key in commit') are revealed without an extra click. Exercises the refactored ReviewRunAccordion / VerdictBanner / FindingsPanel / FindingCard. Read-only seeded data (no model call). Assumes a freshly-seeded DB where acme/payments-api (PR #482) is the first repo — guaranteed by e2e-web.yml; run locally via the hermetic stack (see e2e/README.md). Also hovers the FINDINGS counters on the PR list (read-only popover; the seed has no agent runs, so the timeline tiles are covered by RunHistory unit tests). Then checks the severity counters under the verdict (seed: 1 CRITICAL · 1 WARNING) and that the Warning filter hides the CRITICAL card and a second click restores it.
